home.lead: Altera Company was born from Elyan Sodré's creative direction and today brings together branding, content, and a software engineering team to take your brand from visual identity to digital product — with clarity, strategy, and results.
home.solutionsLead: Projects that align creative direction, market intelligence, and now, software engineering — organized by category to meet your business at every stage.
home.flagshipText: Branding, visual identity, and content that communicate with clarity and build real connection with your audience — the foundation Altera Company built its reputation on, and still our flagship service.
home.ctaSectionTitle: Ready to change the way your brand is seen?
home.ctaSectionText: Tell us which stage of your business needs attention — we'll put together the right solution, from visual identity to digital product.

services.pageLead: Each category solves a different stage of your brand's journey. From visual identity to digital product, choose where to start — or combine fronts to build something complete.

branding-identidade-visual.name: Branding & Visual Identity
branding-identidade-visual.tagline: Authentic brands that position themselves with authority.
branding-identidade-visual.description: We develop everything from the logo to a complete brand manual and the visual system that supports every application of your company — ensuring consistency across every touchpoint with your audience.

social-media-conteudo.name: Social Media & Content
social-media-conteudo.tagline: Strategic management that strengthens your digital presence.
social-media-conteudo.description: We handle your profile end-to-end: posts, carousels, and stories with professional design, feed organization, and management focused on building real connection with your audience.

producao-audiovisual.name: Audiovisual Production
producao-audiovisual.description: We handle the whole process — from scriptwriting and visual concepts to final editing — delivering dynamic content for Reels, TikTok, and ads.
highlights: Content for Reels, TikTok, and ads

performance-digital.name: Digital Performance
performance-digital.tagline: Strategies focused on results and scale.
performance-digital.description: We manage paid traffic campaigns designed to scale your brand's reach and grow your sales, with constant metrics tracking and continuous optimization.
highlights: Funnel strategy aligned with your business

tecnologia.name: Technology Solutions
tecnologia.tagline: Custom digital products for every stage of your business.
tecnologia.description: Our newest front: we combine Altera Company's brand expertise with a software engineering team to build, from the essentials to the advanced, the digital product your business needs — from your first landing page to full platforms.
highlights: Platforms for teams and sales operations

about.title: ALTERA COMPANY
about.lead: A brand born from design that is growing to deliver technology too — without losing the clarity and connection that have always guided us.
about.founderBio: A graduate in Systems Analysis and Development from Estácio de Sá and in Graphic Design from Unopar, Elyan founded Altera Company with a strong focus on branding, creative direction, and social media design. His work is creating visual identities and content that communicate with clarity, position brands, and build real connection with audiences.
about.teamText1: Altera Company still leads with branding and content as its flagship, but our team has grown: we now have a dedicated software engineering team, expanding what we deliver to include websites, apps, dashboards, and custom platforms.
about.teamText2: The goal remains the same — communicating with clarity and building real connection — now also applied to building complete digital products.

contact.title: GET IN TOUCH
contact.lead: Tell us which solution you need — branding, social media, audiovisual, performance, or technology — and we'll get back to you with next steps.
contact.companyText: Send us a direct message about your project.
contact.founderText: Talk directly with the creative director.
